doc.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016

title: Reviews: 'quiet but strong' and 'lyrical and cooking'
summary: Rowe quotes a magazine description of his playing; Rydin cites a similar Edmonton review.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: There’s a publication in my state actually, called New York Cadence Magazine. They describe your playing as, “quiet but strong.”
Oh. I think that was very nice. Yeah. In Edmonton Journal they said, “lyrical and cooking.” And I was very happy with that.
Yeah. You got both ends of the spectrum.
Yes, yes, yes, yes. And I am very happy.
